stats.description: #1: * : The following skills will apply an additional moderate bleed to the target: #1:{None|Keen Strike and Strategic Strike.[G]|Measured Attack and Oppressive Blow.[C]|Sundering Blow and Destabilizing Strike.[H]|Driving Slash and Rohan's Edge.[U]|Flay Open and Spread of Arrows.[T]|Metal and Mettle and Enduring Embers.[L]|Hammer of the Rohan and Cry of the Eorlingas.[I]|Invoke the Elements and Oration of Embers.[K]|Strike with Power and Clash of Steel and Will.[W]| Slash, Bee Swarm[B]| Strike[R]|Quick Strike, Wounding Knife[O]}

1879237905.name: Defensive Riding
1879237905.desc: By placing an emphasis on your defence, you are able to use your war-steed to your advantage and increase your chances to block, parry, and evade enemy attacks.

1879237906.name: Deceptive Appearance
1879237906.desc: The size of your war-steed is misleading, leaving enemies to believe that you can be taken lightly in battle.

1879237909.name: Bond of Morale
1879237909.desc: The bond between rider and war-steed is one that is not easily broken. While together, you rely on each other's presence to push on through even the bleakest of battles and benefit from an increased morale and endurance regeneration.

1879237913.name: Feign Injury
1879237913.desc: By making a momentary withdrawal from battle, you are able to re-enter with decreased aggression from the enemy.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Feign Injury

1879237915.name: Forceful Blows
1879237915.desc: Empowered by the war-steed beneath you, your attacks possess a greater chance to critically hit and bypass the enemy's armour.

1879237916.name: Combat Advantage
1879237916.desc: You leverage the speed and strength of your war-steed into your attacks, allowing  you to deal more damage with physical and tactical abilities.

1879237917.name: Tough Exterior
1879237917.desc: Your time riding has left you hardened to the elements, granting a slight resistance to all types of damage.

1879237918.name: Agility
1879237918.desc: Increases the War-steed's Agility. An increase in your war-steed's agility will contribute to its ability to turn quicker while moving at top speed and contributes to its regeneration vitals.

1879237960.name: Power
1879237960.desc: Increases the War-steed's maximum Power. Increasing your war-steed's power allows the Rider and horse to execute more skills. Your steed's power is slowly drained over time while galloping in combat. With increased power you can push your steed faster and longer during combat.

1879238064.name: Hard to Hit
1879238064.desc: Moving as one, you and your steed are both able to evade incoming attacks with greater ease.

1879238155.name: Armour
1879238155.desc: Increases the War-steed's maximum Armour. The war-steed's armour works similarly as armour on the Rider, as it mitigates incoming damage.

1879238171.name: Sword and Staff
1879238171.desc: You now may dual wield sword and staff.

stats.description: This enables you to use a sword.
This allows the dual wielding of weapons.

1879238282.name: Hard to Hurt
1879238282.desc: Neither you nor your steed are strangers to pain, and your experience makes you harder to hurt while in battle.

1879238290.name: Physical Specimen
1879238290.desc: You and your steed take pride in your training and being in peak physical condition. Your hard work and dedication result in increased physical mastery.

1879238302.name: Tactical Genius
1879238302.desc: Your strength lies in your preparation and strategy, leaving you ready for anything while in battle. Your hard work and dedication result in increased tactical mastery.

1879238311.name: Keen Instincts
1879238311.desc: You have learned to trust your instincts whilst mounted and have become skilled in your ability to parry and block incoming attacks.

1879238326.name: Rapid Recovery
1879238326.desc: Your steed was trained for lengthy and brutal battles, allowing it to regenerate more endurance while in and out of combat.

1879238327.name: Deep Reserves
1879238327.desc: Your steed is battle tested and is comfortable pushing itself to the limit, allowing it to recover more power while in and out of combat.

1879238492.name: Heavy Hand
1879238492.desc: You are in tune with your steed's movements, allowing you to deal greater damage from critical hits.

1879238646.name: Long Reach
1879238646.desc: Your steed understands the danger of battle and helps you land attacks from a greater distance.

1879238650.name: Sacrifice
1879238650.desc: You care deeply for your steed and are able to expend power to protect the steed from sustaining any damage for a time.

stats.description: Unlocks  the skill Sacrifice

1879238655.name: Arise
1879238655.desc: Always able to dig deep, you and your steed are able to gain a second wind, instantly recharging fury and power.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Arise

1879238665.name: Determination
1879238665.desc: You and your steed share a determination to emerge victorious and your resolve grants increased resistances.

1879238953.name: Armour
1879238953.desc: Increases the War-steed's maximum Armour. The war-steed's armour works similarly as armour on the Rider, as it mitigates incoming damage.

1879238955.name: Steel Skin
1879238955.desc: Experience has taught you when a defensive focus is necessary in battle and you have the ability to use your armour to its fullest potential.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Steel Skin.

1879238956.name: Benevolence
1879238956.desc: A generous and honourable individual, you enjoy helping those in need, which increases their benevolence towards you.

1879238957.name: Long Reach
1879238957.desc: Your war-steed understands the danger of battle and helps you land attacks from a greater distance.

1879238960.name: Positive Thinking
1879238960.desc: Your perception is your reality and when you focus on positive results, your morale grows.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Positive Thinking

1879238961.name: Agility
1879238961.desc: Increases the War-steed's Agility. An increase in your war-steed's agility will contribute to its ability to turn quicker while moving at top speed and contributes to its regeneration vitals.

1879238963.name: Cunning
1879238963.desc: Your war-steed's defence is truly unmatched. Both resilient and durable, your steed is able to evade incoming attacks and endure critical hits.

1879238964.name: Strategist
1879238964.desc: You and your war-steed are the perfect combination of brains and brawn, and your sound strategy gives you an edge against tactical attacks.

1879238967.name: Endurance
1879238967.desc: Increases the War-steed's maximum Endurance. Increasing your war-steed's endurance allows it to survive longer in battle.

1879238969.name: Power
1879238969.desc: Increases the War-steed's maximum Power. Increasing your war-steed's power allows the Rider and horse to execute more skills. Your steed's power is slowly drained over time while galloping in combat. With increased power you can push your steed faster and longer during combat.

1879238972.name: Flexibility
1879238972.desc: You have always believed in limbering up before mounting your war-steed, and your experience on horseback has made you adept at blocking and evading attacks while riding.

1879238978.name: Fearless
1879238978.desc: Never shying away from battle, you and your war-steed are able to withstand physical attacks that would fell a lesser man.

1879239023.name: Opportunist
1879239023.desc: Ever the opportunist, you know how to target opponents' weaknesses and are able to inflict massive damage when attacking from behind.

1879239024.name: Precision
1879239024.desc: You are at home while atop your war-steed, and you are confident in your attacks. Your precision while mounted makes it difficult for enemies to evade your attacks.

stats.description:
Reduces your targets ability to evade your attacks.
Rank 1: -10% Evade Chance 
Rank 2: -20% Evade Chance 
Rank 3: -30% Evade Chance

1879239025.name: Overwhelming Offence
1879239025.desc: Your power is overwhelming, and when you attack from horseback, your enemies are hard pressed to block your attacks.

stats.description:
Reduces your targets ability to block your attacks.
Rank 1: -10% Block Chance 
Rank 2: -20% Block Chance 
Rank 3: -30% Block Chance

1879239042.name: Appearance - Female Rohan Warrior
1879239042.desc: Outfit your Rohirrim Woman in a Rohan Warrior Appearance.

1879239044.name: Appearance -  Male Rohan Warrior
1879239044.desc: Outfit your Rohirrim Man in a Rohan Warrior Appearance.

1879239047.name: Rapport
1879239047.desc: The bond between rider and steed is strong, and your experiences together cannot be matched by your foes. This rapport gives you an advantage against other mounted units.

1879239110.name: Bond of Power
1879239110.desc: The bond between rider and war-steed is one that is not easily broken. Drawing inspiration from one another, you are able to push back exhaustion and benefit from an increased power regeneration.

1879239278.name: Mounted Advantage
1879239278.desc: An unmounted enemy is no match for you and your mighty war-steed. Your advantageous position allows you to deal massive damage to these foes.

1879239279.name: Shields Will Be Splintered
1879239279.desc: You show your enemy no mercy, striking where it hurts most, reducing armour and inflicting bleed damage.

1879239280.name: Instigate
1879239280.desc: You know how to get under your opponents' skin and you are able to draw attention away from your weaker allies.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Instigate.

1879239281.name: Well Rounded
1879239281.desc: A well rounded attack is critical to success, and you pride yourself on being a force on both offence and defence.

1879239283.name: Ride for Ruin
1879239283.desc: You fight this battle with all of your strength. Holding nothing back, your attacks have a greater chance to land a critical hit.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Ride for Ruin.

1879239331.name: Trample
1879239331.desc: Your war-steed is an unstoppable force, bearing down on unmounted enemies, trampling them and leaving them in the dirt.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Trample.

1879239333.name: Conservative Combatant
1879239333.desc: You are skilled at conserving energy and are able to expend less energy when performing certain skills.

1879239334.name: Dash
1879239334.desc: Your war-steed is able to sustain its short burst of speed for a longer period of time and dash over a longer distance.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Dash.

1879239340.name: Race: Rohirrim Female
1879239340.desc: You choose a Rohirrim Woman as your Soldier

1879239341.name: Race: Rohirrim Male
1879239341.desc: You choose a Rohirrim Man as your Soldier

1879239554.name: Dash
1879239554.desc: Even when pushed to the limit, your steed is able to dig deep and gain a burst of speed for a short time.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Dash

1879240289.name: Quickness
1879240289.desc: Swift and nimble by nature, your war-steed is able to carry the load, allowing you to focus on the task at hand.

1879241349.name: Elven Light Armour Halter
1879241349.desc: A tooled leather halter set on silk.

1879241350.name: Elven Leaf Halter
1879241350.desc: An intricate halter of leaf-patterned fabric and scaled plating.

1879241351.name: Steed of Night Halter
1879241351.desc: The trademark headgear of the steeds of the Eldgang. The glowing symbols burn brightly even on the darkest of nights.

1879241352.name: Withywindle Halter
1879241352.desc: A halter of leather and fabric fit for adventuring through the deepest woods.

1879241353.name: Dagorlad Halter
1879241353.desc: A striking halter made from leather and sturdy chainmail.

1879241354.name: Bone Halter
1879241354.desc: Mighty was Smaug the Golden. Mighty also is this intimidating headdress, fashioned in the likeness of Smaug's ancient bones.

1879241355.name: Victory Halter
1879241355.desc: A sleek, studded halter cut from fine leather.

1879241356.name: Elven Leaf Caparison
1879241356.desc: This fine barding was hand-worked by the master tailors and goldsmiths of Lórien.

1879241357.name: Elven Wing Halter
1879241357.desc: This splendid halter, made of dark leather and winged accents, boasts the true glory of the Galadhrim.

1879241358.name: Elven Light Armour Saddle
1879241358.desc: A beautiful saddle crafted with care by Miluidan, master leather-worker of Rivendell.

1879241359.name: Citadel Accessory
1879241359.desc: The Tower Guards of Minas Tirith use this dependable gear while on patrol beyond the city walls.

1879241360.name: Esgaroth Halter
1879241360.desc: A halter of plated leather like the ones used by the Men of Dale in the Battle of Five Armies.

1879241361.name: Bone Caparison
1879241361.desc: These bones rest atop a blanket of ragged silk, and are made in imitation of the ribcage of a fearsome dragon of old.

1879241362.name: Citadel Saddle
1879241362.desc: A sleek black-and-silver saddle. By day it glistens like silver. By night it is like a shade, allowing steed and rider to pass unseen.

1879241363.name: Victory Caparison
1879241363.desc: This heavy, plated black leather and crimson caparison will offer both style and protection to any war-steed.

1879241364.name: Bone Saddle
1879241364.desc: An impressive saddle made of rawhide and carved bone.

1879241365.name: Bone Leggings
1879241365.desc: The muddy bones of fallen beasts, hollowed of their marrow and fastened to dark leather straps.

1879241366.name: Elven Wing Leggings
1879241366.desc: Be shown the meaning of haste with these beautiful winged leg-guards, and run as smoothly as a swift stream.

1879241367.name: Dagorlad Leggings
1879241367.desc: Now for wrath, now for ruin and a red nightfall!

1879241368.name: Dol Baran Leggings
1879241368.desc: Leggings like these bore the Grey Company and its steeds swiftly over the plains.

1879241369.name: Esgaroth Leggings
1879241369.desc: Warm and sturdy leg-guards in the signature colours of Lake-town.

1879241370.name: Steed of Night Accessory
1879241370.desc: Two elegant leather pouches and a slim black bedroll, perfect for short trips.

1879241371.name: Iron Hills Halter
1879241371.desc: A worn leather halter, carefully crafted to protect the War-steed.

1879241372.name: Marauder Accessory
1879241372.desc: Weather-worn burlap pouches and sharp but simple axe.

1879241373.name: Iron Hills Leggings
1879241373.desc: Sturdy Dwarf-make leg guards made for colder weather.

1879241374.name: Withywindle Saddle
1879241374.desc: A fine leather saddle with elegant gold tooling.

1879241375.name: Dol Baran Caparison
1879241375.desc: When the Rangers of the Grey Company set out to join their chieftain in the south, they dressed their faithftul steeds in dull but fearsome armour such as this.

1879241376.name: Esgaroth Tail
1879241376.desc: An intricate leather tail-wrap of traditional Dalish design.

1879241377.name: Elven Wing Caparison
1879241377.desc: Elegant green barding made for riding beneath the dappled shade of the mellyrn of Lórien.

1879241378.name: Victory Accessory
1879241378.desc: Sturdy leather saddlebags fit for carrying a variety of gear.

1879241379.name: Victory Leggings
1879241379.desc: Fashionable but functional leg guards made of fabric and leather.

1879241380.name: Elven Light Armour Caparison
1879241380.desc: The merry Elves of Rivendell favour this festive barding of red, gold, and green like the trees of their beloved home.

1879241381.name: Dagorlad Saddle
1879241381.desc: A tough leather saddle made to endure the elements.

1879241382.name: Withywindle Leggings
1879241382.desc: Light-weight leather leg-guards built for moving swiftly through thick undergrowth.

1879241383.name: Withywindle Caparison
1879241383.desc: Inspired by the bark and foliage of the Old Forest, this sturdy barding will last through the most taxing of adventures.

1879241384.name: Steed of Night Saddle
1879241384.desc: A large, sturdy saddle made to provide comfort when riding the harsh terrain of Nûrz Ghâshu.

1879241385.name: Steed of Night Caparison
1879241385.desc: The caparisons of the Eldgangs' war-steeds blaze brightly in the ever-looming shadow of Nûrz Ghâshu.

1879241386.name: Dagorlad Accessory
1879241386.desc: A sturdy round shield and well-made dwarf-made sword to keep at the ready for unexpected combat.

1879241387.name: Iron Hills Caparison
1879241387.desc: This thick brown caparison was fashioned by the steady hands of the Dwarves of the Iron Hills.

1879241388.name: Elven Leaf Saddle
1879241388.desc: A dark leather saddle of Elven-craft, with gold and silver accents.

1879241389.name: Iron Hills Saddle
1879241389.desc: A sturdy cold-weather saddle bearing the maker's mark of the Iron Hills.

1879241390.name: Bone Tail
1879241390.desc: A cloth and bone ornament for the tail of a war-steed.

1879241391.name: Marauder Caparison
1879241391.desc: This hastily assembled armour of mesh and burlap is not made to last, but is still wicked to the eye that beholds it.

1879241392.name: Esgaroth Saddle
1879241392.desc: A fine Dalish saddle made of burnished red leather.

1879241393.name: Elven Leaf Leggings
1879241393.desc: Striking teal leg-guards with leaf-patterned gold plate.

1879241394.name: Esgaroth Caparison
1879241394.desc: The Bowmen of Bard rode to the Battle of Five Armies upon steeds clad in brown and burgundy, and were fearsome to behold.

1879241395.name: Citadel Halter
1879241395.desc: A halter modelled after those used by the Tower Guard of Minas Tirith.

1879241396.name: Dol Baran Saddle
1879241396.desc: This saddle is favoured by the Grey Company for its light weight, sturdiness, and simplicity.

1879241397.name: Marauder Halter
1879241397.desc: A makeshift halter patched together by burlap scraps and wire mesh.

1879241398.name: Elven Light Armour Leggings
1879241398.desc: Colourful leather leg guards used by the cherished steeds of Rivendell. Light is their footfall in the woods.

1879241399.name: Steed of Night Leggings
1879241399.desc: Sturdy iron leg-guards accented with leather.

1879241400.name: Marauder Leggings
1879241400.desc: Studded leather plate strapped to stiff burlap sleeves.

1879241401.name: Victory Saddle
1879241401.desc: A heavy saddle of black leather reinforced with iron discs.

1879241402.name: Citadel Leggings
1879241402.desc: Geometric leggings of forged steel, yet black as jet.

1879241403.name: Dagorlad Caparison
1879241403.desc: Rugged black leather and heavy chainmail made to carry any rider safely through any battle.

1879241404.name: Dol Baran Halter
1879241404.desc: This jagged leather is sure to intimadate even the mightiest of foes.

1879241405.name: Elven Wing Saddle
1879241405.desc: A majestic green saddle with a saddlehorn fasioned in the shape of a leaping horse.

1879241406.name: Marauder Saddle
1879241406.desc: A simple, light saddle of black leather held together by imperfect stitch-work.

1879241407.name: Citadel Caparison
1879241407.desc: It is said that Beregond of the Minas Tirith Tower Guard decorates his beloved steed in armour much like this.

1879241834.name: Spears Will Be Shaken
1879241834.desc: Your attacks leave opponents shaken, hobbled and unable to escape your onslaught.

1879242056.desc: Even in the face of insurmountable odds, you fight with a ferocity never before seen by your foes.

1879242063.name: Motivation through Aggression
1879242063.desc: The effects of your critical hits inspire those around you, giving them the motivation needed to continue the fight.

1879242064.name: Disengaging Strikes
1879242064.desc: Your critical hits strike with such precision as to catch your enemy off-guard, providing a chance to dismount them instantly.

stats.description: #1: * : While utilizing the Riddermark Discipline the following skills have a 25% chance to instantly dismount the target when they critically hit: #1:{None|Ride By, Keen Strike[G]|Cry Havoc, Cry Wrath[C]|Swift Cut, Destabilizing Strike, Horn Blast[H]|Driving Slash, Staggering Slash, Rohan's Edge[U]|Flay Open, Noble Arrow, Spread of Arrows[T]|Enduring Embers, Bond of the Rider[L]|Hammer of Rohan, Cry of the Eorlingas, Coda of the Eorlingas[I]|Fixation of Storm, Oration of the Bleak Sky, Resolution of Storms[K]|Assault of the Eorlingas, Clash of Steel and Will, Skill of the Eorlingas[W]| Biting Edge, Execute[B]| Momentous Hit[R]| Quick Strike, Precise Blade, Anchored Thrust[O]|Quick Strike, Precise Blade, Anchored Thrust[O]}

1879242710.name: Intimidate
1879242710.desc: You are able to intimidate your opponent, striking fear into their heart so that they flee in terror.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Intimidate.

1879242797.name: Coax
1879242797.desc: You are able to get inside your opponent's head and coax mounted enemies into riding alongside of you, engaging in close quarters combat.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Coax.

1879244264.name: Dash
1879244264.desc: As a result of constant conditioning your war-steed is very slow to tire. Its Dash skill becomes a toggle and is able to remain active so long as your war-steed has enough power.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Dash

1879244308.name: Strong Willed
1879244308.desc: You are able to dig deep when necessary, allowing your effects a longer duration or greater chance of success.

1879244944.name: Caution
1879244944.desc: Your ferocity in battle keeps your enemies at bay, leaving them unsure as to whether they should fight or flee.

stats.description: Unlocks the skill Caution

1879245608.name: War-steed Riding
1879245608.desc: You are able to ride war-steeds.
1879245608.tooltip: You are able to ride war-steeds.

1879245674.name: Deadly Pursuit
1879245674.desc: While pursuing an enemy, you have the ability to find the weakness in their armour and execute attacks that apply bleed damage.

stats.description: All class skills that deal damage will apply a moderate bleed effect when attacking from behind

1879245720.name: Savagery
1879245720.desc: You are able to tap into your less refined side and attack with devastating force, multiplying the damage done by critical attacks.

1879245798.name: Battle Tested
1879245798.desc: No stranger to the field of battle, your war-steed fights like it feels no pain, allowing it to recover quickly while in combat.

1879245799.name: Rehabilitation
1879245799.desc: War is a means to an end, but your steed finds peace when the battle is done, allowing it to recover quickly outside of combat.

1879245800.name: Determination
1879245800.desc: You and your war-steed share a determination to emerge victorious and your resolve grants increased resistances.

1879245877.name: Patience
1879245877.desc: You understand that most battles cannot be won quickly, and you are able to conserve your energy when performing physical skills.

1879245880.name: Understanding
1879245880.desc: Your steed understands when you choose to attack from a distance and remains steady, allowing you to perform tactical skills with less effort.

1879250358.name: Rune-keeper's Leggings
1879250358.desc: The Rune-keeper's flight into battle is a prelude to hope for all those who cannot fight. These runed leg-guards guide a steed easily toward the foe.

1879250359.name: Metal Braided Tail
1879250359.desc: Dusky purple ribbon held in place by sturdy iron bolts.

1879250360.name: Heavy Accessory of the Sutcrofts
1879250360.desc: These bold and festive saddlebags will leave no mystery about where your loyalties lie.

1879250361.name: Heavy Leggings of the Entwash
1879250361.desc: These flared leg guards add visual balance to the traditional battle-gear of Eaworth's steeds.

1879250363.name: Heavy Halter of the Sutcrofts
1879250363.desc: A sturdy, highly-decorated saddle of thick leather used by the vigilant guards of the Sutcrofts.

1879250365.name: Maverick's Accessory
1879250365.desc: The favoured trappings of the lone dissenter, he who sees the King's descent into dotage, and is not afraid to rebel against the wicked whisperings of Gríma Wormtongue.

1879250367.name: Khundolar Halter
1879250367.desc: A fierce eastern-make battle halter of tough leather beneath engraved silver plates.

1879250368.name: Light Leggings of the Sutcrofts
1879250368.desc: These simple leg-guards help to keep a steed's legs free of mud when working the fields after recent rain.

1879250370.name: Lore-master's Saddle
1879250370.desc: Perched high in her broad saddle, the Lore-master is a beacon of hope to those who have lost it. Her knowledge of the past gives rise to a better future.

1879250371.name: Gatherer's Accessory
1879250371.desc: A useful gear set for anyone who makes a living by gathering the natural bounty of Middle-earth.

1879250372.name: Hunter's Gear
1879250372.desc: The Hunter's art is one of simple harmony with nature. Hunters carry only what they need to survive in the wild.

1879250373.name: Heavy Caparison of the Norcrofts
1879250373.desc: When the Men of the Norcrofts are called to war, they dress their beloved steeds in decorative barding made for both strength and speed.

1879250374.name: Light Saddle of the Sutcrofts
1879250374.desc: A simple saddle, well-worn by years of use in the fields of the Eastemnet.

1879250375.name: Heavy Accessory of the Entwash
1879250375.desc: A heavy accessory from the people of the Entwash.

1879250376.name: Heavy Halter of the Entwash
1879250376.desc: A heavy halter from the people of the Entwash.

1879250377.name: Warrior's Accessory
1879250377.desc: Mercenaries know the importance of being able to travel at a moment's notice. Their rough and simple belongings are all that is needed to earn a living by the sword.

1879250378.name: Rohirrim Elite Caparison
1879250378.desc: The riders of Rohan thunder across the grassy seas of their homeland in silver and green. This caparison bears the image of a rampant white horse.

1879250379.name: Light Halter of the Wold
1879250379.desc: This colourful cloth halter will protect your steed's face from the dusty winds of the Wold.

1879250380.name: Obsidian Halter
1879250380.desc: A fierce, heavy halter made of jagged leather and accented with veins of silver.

1879250381.name: Rohirrim Elite Saddle
1879250381.desc: A fine leather saddle accented with silver filigree, used by the famed Riders of Rohan as they patrol the bounds of their beloved home.

1879250382.name: Light Leggings of the Entwash
1879250382.desc: These tough leg guards are meant for pushing aside the reeds and rushes that grow thickly in the Entwash marshes.

1879250383.name: Nightwood Halter
1879250383.desc: A well-stitched, full halter made of coloured silk.

1879250384.name: Light Saddle of the Norcrofts
1879250384.desc: A light-weight and versatile leather saddle common in the Norcrofts.

1879250385.name: Burglar's Leggings
1879250385.desc: When a practical joke goes sour, a speedy getaway becomes necessary. These leather leg guards help a steed to fly to safety.

1879250386.name: Medium Banded Leather Halter
1879250386.desc: A ceremonial halter of cloth and studded leather, often used by the Rohirrim to celebrate the end of a battle.

1879250387.name: Medium Banded Leather Saddle
1879250387.desc: An intricate, ceremonial saddle formed from black leather, traditional in Rohirric celebrations.

1879250388.name: Light Halter of the Norcrofts
1879250388.desc: This halter is mostly used to show the heraldry of Cliving, but it affords the steed who wears it some protection, as well.

1879250389.name: Rhûn Halter
1879250389.desc: A stark hauberk decorated with traditional Easterling needlework.

1879250390.name: Champion's Gear
1879250390.desc: True heroics do not stem from battle acuity only, but also preparedness. Extra armour, blades, and rations can often make the difference between a failure and a legend.

1879250391.name: Rhûn Saddle
1879250391.desc: An elegant, high-backed saddled made in the likeness of an exotic bird.

1879250392.name: Champion's Halter
1879250392.desc: Many depend upon the Champion, who must fight on even through the red haze of battle. The Champion's steed, too, must be prepared to cut through the enemy defences.

1879250394.name: Obsidian Saddle
1879250394.desc: An intricate patterned saddle fashioned after the work of Dunlending weavers.

1879250395.name: Heavy Halter of the Norcrofts
1879250395.desc: A fancy, elegant halter used by Norcrofts soldiers when they go into battle.

1879250396.name: Nightwood Saddle
1879250396.desc: A striking saddle made of bright silk stitched onto formed black leather.

1879250397.name: Burglar's Saddle
1879250397.desc: Mounted combat can be touch and go at times, especially for those who favour knives. A flat, simple saddle allows for maximum manoeuvrability.

1879250398.name: Light Halter of the Sutcrofts
1879250398.desc: A simple, dependable halter built for working horses.

1879250400.name: Rune-keeper's Gear
1879250400.desc: A Rune-keeper's chilling rhetoric is expertly crafted from the secrets found in ancient tomes and stone tablets. Everything the Rune-keeper needs for victory must be kept close at hand.

1879250401.name: Grand Accessory
1879250401.desc: An ornate and striking pair of saddlebags meant more for making a statement than for functionality. Inspired by the bold, patterned fabrics woven in the faraway land of Rhûn.

1879250402.name: Rune-keeper's Caparison
1879250402.desc: The essence of winter is woven into this striking caparison, threaded with veins of cold silver.

1879250404.name: Heavy Halter of the Wold
1879250404.desc: The people of the Wold are Rohan's noble bulwark, forever keeping vigil against threats from across the Anduin.

1879250405.name: Khundolar Saddle
1879250405.desc: A sleek, high-backed saddle made of silk stretched over formed leather.

1879250406.name: Guardian's Leggings
1879250406.desc: A mighty charge can overpower even the doughtiest of foes. These black leather leggings are near impervious to wear.

1879250407.name: Merchant's Accessory
1879250407.desc: These roomy saddlebags are of southern-make, and must have been claimed from a merchant caravan travelling north from Harad. They still smell of tea and spices.

1879250409.name: Burglar's Caparison
1879250409.desc: This dark and mottled barding blends effortlessly into shadow, allowing Burglar and steed to hide in plain sight.

1879250410.name: Light Saddle of the Wold
1879250410.desc: Light, comfortable saddles like this one are necessary for traversing the harsh and unpredictable terrain of the Wold.

1879250412.name: Light Leggings of the Wold
1879250412.desc: When riding over the rocky, pockmarked hills of the Wold, it is essential to clothe your steed in durable leg-guards that will not snag on rock or thorn.

1879250413.name: Accessory of the North Star
1879250413.desc: It was Elbereth Gilthoniel who kindled the stars into being. Now a master craftsman has embroidered that starlight into these elegant saddlebags, that they might guide you wherever you go.

1879250415.name: Lore-master's Halter
1879250415.desc: Lore-masters understand well the power of knowledge, and use it to expertly shield their beloved steeds from the elements.

1879250417.name: Rune-keeper's Halter
1879250417.desc: The Rune-keeper's fiery ridicule is mirrored in this striking silver-edged halter, as neither steed nore rider feels sympathy for their twisted foe.

1879250418.name: Rhûn Caparison
1879250418.desc: A bold Easterling caparison set over sturdy black leather straps and embroidered with fine gold needlework.

1879250419.name: Guardian's Gear
1879250419.desc: The Guardian carries only the essentials—those items that may help turn the tables in a seemingly impossible battle.

1879250420.name: Light Caparison of the Norcrofts
1879250420.desc: Sometimes, defence must be sacrificed for agility. This light-weight tack won't protect the steed from harm, but it will allow it to fly across the plains.

1879250421.name: Medium Banded Leather Caparison
1879250421.desc: Black leather straps decorated with molded iron roses and set beneath a trailing. Embroidered saddle blanket.

1879250423.name: Light Halter of the Entwash
1879250423.desc: Cold and unsentimental winds blow across the faded grasses and lonely downs of the Entwash Vale. Practical leather halters like this help to protect a steed from the elements.

1879250424.name: Heavy Leggings of the Wold
1879250424.desc: Heavy leggings from the people of the Wold

1879250425.name: Accessory of the Merchant
1879250425.desc: A number of sturdy bags with multiple compartments made to hold a travelling merchant's extensive inventory.

1879250427.name: Nightwood Caparison
1879250427.desc: A fancy full-body caparison made of intricately embroidered silk.

1879250428.name: Lore-master's Gear
1879250428.desc: A Lore-master studies ancient craft to better understand the past. Tomes, scrolls, and maps from elder days help her to find success in the present ones.

1879250430.name: Heavy Caparison of the Entwash
1879250430.desc: In his days as a captain in the King's guard, Ingbert and his steed rode to battle in magnificent armour like this. The full-body caparison bears the clean lines of a lyre, the symbol of Reeve Ingbert's house.

1879250432.name: Greenwood Saddle
1879250432.desc: Though the Greenwood is now twisted by shadow and by spite, the art of the Elves who loved it persists. This elegant, tooled leather saddle is a reminder of fair days long ago.

1879250433.name: Obsidian Caparison
1879250433.desc: A striking, heavy-duty caparison made of silver-embroidered tapestry and sleek, shaped leather.

1879250434.name: Vagabond's Accessory
1879250434.desc: To some, the road is a place between where you are and where you must go; to others, the road is home. This versatile gear set is made for a simple, easy life in the saddle.

1879250435.name: Heavy Leggings of the Norcrofts
1879250435.desc: Behold the thunderous hoofbeats of your steed as you ride together over the weathered rock and withered grass.

1879250437.name: Lore-master's Leggings
1879250437.desc: The silver stars upon these leggings flash brightly as the Lore-master's steed runs like a gust of wind toward new discoveries.

1879250438.name: Rohirrim Elite Tail
1879250438.desc: A durable green-and-gold metal plate made to hold a steed's tail neatly in place as he makes haste through the oceans of grass

1879250439.name: Rune-keeper's Saddle
1879250439.desc: The vivid imagery of defeat is but an illusion to the Rune-keeper, secure in this high-backed wooden saddle and protected by crystal wards.

1879250440.name: Khundolar Caparison
1879250440.desc: A magnificent eastern-make caparison and delicately embroidered, quilted saddle blanket. Silver coins are strung from the engraved plates to bring good fortune to the warrior.

1879250443.name: Burglar's Halter
1879250443.desc: The Burglar's advantage is rooted in stealth, so much so that even his beloved steed must be cloaked in mystery as well.

1879250444.name: Heavy Accessory of the Norcrofts
1879250444.desc: A gaily-coloured pair of saddlebags bearing the lyre, the symbol of Reeve Ingbert's house.

1879250447.name: Heavy Saddle of the Wold
1879250447.desc: The wide and featureless face of the Wold makes for a long patrol. A comfortable saddle makes a world of difference.

1879250448.name: Rohirrim Elite Leggings
1879250448.desc: As steed and rider fly to meet their foe, these green metal leg guards will cut through any brush that stands in their way.

1879250449.name: Obsidian Tail
1879250449.desc: Formed leather is tough to come by, but not with this tail accessory.

1879250453.name: Heavy Accessory
1879250453.desc: Four strong, doeskin saddlebags that won't slip off during strenuous travel, and will keep gear dry through any downpour.

1879250456.name: Guardian's Halter
1879250456.desc: A practical halter of tough, cured leather and durable steel rings to keep a steed safe in the thrill of danger.

1879250459.name: Torchbearer's Accessory
1879250459.desc: The Beacons of Gondor must be watched day and night, lest the need for aid from Gondor's territories arise. Those Men who watch the beacons know the importance of their task, and must be ready to kindle the flames at a moment's notice.

1879250460.name: Heavy Saddle of the Entwash
1879250460.desc: A beautiful, fur-lined saddle made by the people of the Entwash Vale. Though fancier than usual, it has not lost its practical feel.

1879250461.name: Lore-master's Caparison
1879250461.desc: The Lore-master dresses her steed in this starry pattern to invoke the favour of Elbereth, Star-kindler, in hopes that her cry to the Valar might be answered when she is in need.

1879250462.name: Champion's Leggings
1879250462.desc: A Champion in battle-frenzy must press ever forward, deeper into the heart of battle. These Damascus leg guards help the Champion's steed carry him there.

1879250463.name: Accessory of the Easterlings
1879250463.desc: Two exotic saddlebags hung with bright orange tassels, and lined with the fur of a predatory cat.

1879250465.name: Burglar's Gear
1879250465.desc: Quick-fingered Burglars get themselves into a great deal of mischief, and need lots of places to store their liberated treasures.

1879250466.name: Greenwood Leggings
1879250466.desc: Contoured leather leg guards like these once helped the Elves of the Greenwood to patrol their borders with efficiency and silence.

1879250467.name: Champion's Caparison
1879250467.desc: A Champion stands adamant even in the face of defeat. This fierce Damascus plate mail will keep the Champion's steed safe to the last.

1879250468.name: Light Caparison of the Entwash
1879250468.desc: This simple cloth caparison depicts a gilded harp, much like the one carried by the exiled minstrel Horn, son of Reeve Ingbert of Eaworth.

1879250469.name: Greenwood Caparison
1879250469.desc: Mirkwood was known as Greenwood the Great, Thranduil's archers rode through the verdant wood on steeds dressed in the gentle colours of spring.

1879250470.name: Light Caparison of the Wold
1879250470.desc: Through brake and bramble, fen and tussock, the steeds of the Wold carry their masters safely home.

1879250471.name: Dwarf-made Accessory
1879250471.desc: These reliable suede saddlebags are double-stitched and built to last. The tough black boots are helpful for times when you must ford marshy terrain on foot.

1879250473.name: Heavy Saddle of the Sutcrofts
1879250473.desc: A sturdy, highly-decorated saddle of thick leather used by the vigilant guards of the Sutcrofts.

1879250474.name: Heavy Caparison of the Wold
1879250474.desc: The Men of the Wold see themselves as all that stands between Rohan and her doom. They proudly display their heraldry when they ride to meet any foe of Rohan.

1879250475.name: Heavy Saddle of the Norcrofts
1879250475.desc: A high-backed, regulation saddle used by the soldiers of the Norcrofts.

1879250476.name: Light Leggings of the Norcrofts
1879250476.desc: Simple, understated cloth leg-guards fashioned by the tailors of the Norcrofts.

1879250477.name: Long Metallic Tail
1879250477.desc: Shining silver scales that fit snugly on a war-steed's tail.

1879250479.name: Braided Flower Tail
1879250479.desc: Hammered metal flowers and shining purple ribbons that will keep your war-steed's tail stylish and clean.

1879250482.name: Short Metallic Tail
1879250482.desc: Sturdy iron ornaments of dwarf-make that won't come loose even in the heat of battle.

1879250483.name: Khundolar Leggings
1879250483.desc: Quilted, embroidered leg guards made to provide support without adding weight.

1879250485.name: Heavy Caparison of the Sutcrofts
1879250485.desc: The guards who protect Garsfeld, Snowbourn and Walstow bear this heraldry proudly as they ride their bounds.

1879250486.name: Short Fluffed Tail
1879250486.desc: A tight gold wrapping accented with leather strips, perfect for keeping shorter tails clean.

1879250487.name: Light Saddle of the Entwash
1879250487.desc: The Entwash Vale is a stark and lonely land, and its people are practical. This basic leather saddle does everything it needs to, and nothing more.

1879250489.name: Heavy Accessory of the Wold
1879250489.desc: A heavy accessory from the people of the Wold

1879250490.name: Woven Leather Tail
1879250490.desc: A brightly-coloured tail wrap made of red satin ribbon and gold beads.

1879250493.name: Short Armoured Tail
1879250493.desc: A striking tail ornament of gilded leather.

1879250496.name: Obsidian Leggings
1879250496.desc: Simple, functional leg-guards built to protect a steed's sensitive shins.

1879250497.name: Champion's Saddle
1879250497.desc: From high in this gilded metal saddle, the Champion rains feral strikes down upon the foe to carve a path to victory.

1879250498.name: Guardian's Caparison
1879250498.desc: Strong is the warrior's heart, and so too is his armour. This shielded leather barding is made to last.

1879250499.name: Diamond Banded Tail
1879250499.desc: Three diamond-shaped golden plates that look best on long, elegant tails.

1879250500.name: Rohirrim Elite Halter
1879250500.desc: This impenetrable halter is made of dyed metal plate and rough green fabric. The steeds ridden by the Third Marshall's men wear halters like these.

1879250501.name: Nightwood Leggings
1879250501.desc: Sturdy leather leg guards accented with colourful silk.

1879250502.name: Turtle Shield Tail
1879250502.desc: A sturdy tail ornament with a turtle motif, inspired by Dunlending craft.

1879250503.name: Royal Accessory
1879250503.desc: For some, it is not enough to travel simply. Wealth that is had should be flaunted. These gilded, opulent saddlebags do just that.

1879250504.name: Shielded Tail
1879250504.desc: Heavy metal ornaments designed to keep a tail hanging low and straight.

1879250505.name: Guardian's Saddle
1879250505.desc: A dependable leather saddle is all the Guardian needs to catch a breath amidst a fight.

1879250506.name: Medium Banded Leather Leggings
1879250506.desc: Embroidered cloth leggings made for celebratory parades through the towns of the Estemnet.

1879250508.name: Leather Wrapped Tail
1879250508.desc: Decorated formed leather that fits snugly on your war-steed's tail.

1879250509.name: Heavy Leggings of the Sutcrofts
1879250509.desc: The guards of Sutcrofts spare no details when outfitting their steeds for protection.

1879250510.name: Greenwood Halter
1879250510.desc: Thranduil's archers once favoured armour in the colours of a newborn forest, and clothed their steeds in these as well.

1879250512.name: Rhûn Leggings
1879250512.desc: Ceremonial, embroidered leggings used by Khundolar warriors to decorate their steeds.

1879250513.name: Light Caparison of the Sutcrofts
1879250513.desc: The crofters of Rohan use sturdy, functional tack when outfitting the horses that join them every day in the wide fields.

1879250514.name: Accessory Bins
1879250514.desc: Two slender saddlebags perfect for holding an assortment of travel accessories.

1879250515.name: Axeman's Accessory
1879250515.desc: Style and power combined into one efficient set of travel gear for warriors who cannot afford excess.

1879250516.name: Traveller's Accessory
1879250516.desc: A simple set of saddlebags built for carrying only the essentials, meant for swift and urgent travel over long distances.

1879250517.name: Antlers Accessory
1879250517.desc: The solitary Eglain make use of whatever materials they can find. These rough saddlebags of antler and rawhide are an example of their resourcefulness.

1879250518.name: Assassin's Accessory
1879250518.desc: This versatile assassin's set includes everything one needs to get the job done quickly and quietly. It is favoured by the shadowed figures who lurk in the corners of the Prancing Pony.

1879251852.name: Solid War-steed
1879251852.desc: A single-coloured pelt free of any distinct markings.

1879251853.name: Overo War-steed
1879251853.desc: Overo is a term for a pinto coloured horse with distinct, irregular white-over-dark patterning on its hide. The darker patches can occur in any solid base colour.

1879251854.name: Bay War-steed
1879251854.desc: A bay is characterized by black points on the legs, mane and tail. It is a base colour from which many other variations spring.

1879251855.name: Tobiano War-steed
1879251855.desc: A common spotted colour pattern common in pintos. The skin underneath the white-haired patches is pink in colour. Tobiano pelts are common, and do not fade as a horse ages.

1879251856.name: Brindle War-steed
1879251856.desc: An incredibly rare horse colouring. It occurs when a horse or pony possesses both a dark base colour and a lighter shade on top of it, which gives the appearance of stripes on the neck, back, and hindquarters.

1879251857.name: Shaggy Roan War-steed
1879251857.desc: A roan is any horse that has an even mix of dark and white hairs growing on its pelt. The lower legs, mane, and tail are usually darker in colour. Roan is a common coat colour, and can be found in many breeds.

1879251858.name: Dappled War-steed
1879251858.desc: Dappled horses are covered in light spots that bring to mind mottled sunlight falling through a leafy canopy.

1879251859.name: Spotted War-steed
1879251859.desc: This spotted pelt is an Appaloosa variation that results from white being overlaid on top of base coat colours. It is a very old colouration, and occurs in many breeds.

1879251860.name: Fleabitten War-steed
1879251860.desc: A fleabitten coat is a speckled pattern, usually light in colour, that occurs as a horse ages.  It occurs when red-coloured hairs begin to grow on the horse's pelt, often in great abundance.

1879251880.name: Hunter's Saddle
1879251880.desc: A rustic saddle of wood and leather like this allows the Hunter to stay connected to the strength of the earth.

1879251881.name: Minstrel's Gear
1879251881.desc: A set of simple instruments – lute, drum, bagpipes, and tambourine – that the Minstrel may use to raise the spirits even in the thick of battle.

1879251882.name: Warden's Halter
1879251882.desc: This fine plate-and-tassel regalia suits the Warden, for whom battle is not a duty but a celebration of skill.

1879251883.name: Survivalist's Accessory
1879251883.desc: The wild places of Middle-earth are treacherous to the unprepared. The survivalist anticipates every need.

1879251884.name: Red Guard Elite Leggings
1879251884.desc: Sturdy metal leg guards dyed a dark burgundy.

1879251886.name: Minstrel's Saddle
1879251886.desc: When it comes time to sound the anthem of war, the minstrel chooses a sturdy saddle of silver and gold to carry her into battle.

1879251887.name: Red Guard Elite Caparison
1879251887.desc: A wine-red, formal caparison emblazoned with the bold Rohan sun.

1879251888.name: Hunter's Caparison
1879251888.desc: This oiled cloth caparison, covered by a warn bearskin, helps to camouflage the Hunter's steed in the deep woods.

1879251890.name: Warden's Caparison
1879251890.desc: In battle the Warden is a wall of steel, and so too should be his steed. This strong plate mail provides a war-steed with weight and force enough to topple any foe.

1879251891.name: Warden's Gear
1879251891.desc: A store of essentials, such as cookware, a repair kit, and a spare shield, helps the Warden to persevere through hardship, expected or otherwise.

1879251892.name: Captain's Saddle
1879251892.desc: All good Captains must be able to command respect on the battle-field. This high, heavy metal saddle ensures a clear view of the field.

1879251893.name: Captain's Leggings
1879251893.desc: An escape from darkness requires uncompromised speed. These light-weight metal guards will not slow the Captain's rushing steed.

1879251894.name: Hunter's Leggings
1879251894.desc: When desperate flight is necessary, these fur-lined leather leggings will not snag on treacherous roots or thorns.

1879251895.name: Captain's Halter
1879251895.desc: Because the Captain must stand in harm's way to shelter her comrades, her steed, too, must be heavily armoured in well-oiled steel plate.

1879251896.name: Minstrel's Halter
1879251896.desc: A merry halter of motley and bright red ribbon for the steed who aids the Minstrel's noble cause.

1879251897.name: Red Guard Elite Halter
1879251897.desc: A mighty, heavy halter of burnished silver and rich, red velvet.

1879251898.name: Warden's Saddle
1879251898.desc: A strong but flexible saddle helps to safe-guard the Warden in battle.

1879251899.name: Minstrel's Caparison
1879251899.desc: A festive motley blanket hung with tiny silver bells that chime out the melody of battle.

1879251900.name: Red Guard Elite Saddle
1879251900.desc: A fine leather saddle accented with silver filigree.

1879251901.name: Hunter's Halter
1879251901.desc: This sleek halter keeps a steed's mane out of the way of snagging branches, and helps steed and rider to find the path in thick and shadowed undergrowth.

1879251902.name: Warden's Leggings
1879251902.desc: When on the brink of victory, these heavy leg guards can give both steed and rider the momentum they need to ensure a win.

1879251903.name: Minstrel's Leggings
1879251903.desc: Cross-gartered leggings of silken ribbon that match the Minstrel's triumphant spirit.

1879251904.name: Captain's Caparison
1879251904.desc: The Captain acts as a herald of hope to the Free Peoples of Middle-earth, and so her steed is dressed in festive barding meant to dazzle and inspire.

1879251905.name: Captain's Gear
1879251905.desc: In a time of need, the Captain must have everything she requires, such as a bedroll and her helmet, within easy reach.

1879251906.name: Red Guard Elite Tail
1879251906.desc: A durable red-and-gold metal plate made to hold a steed's tail neatly in place.

1879253535.name: Horsehead's Banner Accessory
1879253535.desc: This bright flag leaves no question about for whose side you fight. As you ride to war, show your foes that Rohan is a force to be feared.

1879253536.name: King's Banner Accessory
1879253536.desc: Let fly the colours of Théoden King! Show your enemies whose land it is they threaten, and assure it is the last thing they ever learn.

1879253566.name: Simple Tail
1879253566.desc: Let your War-steed's tail flow free and wild, the way it was meant to be.

1879255609.name: Orc Head on a Pike Accessory
1879255609.desc: The head of an Orc on a pike. A gruesome trophy.

1879391214.name: Shadow of the Eye
1879391214.desc: Reduced Vitality - Known to the Orcs of Mordor as shakglob, or Stone-filth, the Stout-axes have long served as thralls of the Dark Lord of Mordor. After enduring years of tireless labour and ill-nourishment, the Stout-axes have lost some of the sturdiness they once possessed.

1879391215.name: Unyielding Will
1879391215.desc: Increased Will - Despite suffering many centuries of thralldom, the will of the Stout-axes has never broken.
1879391215.tooltip: Increased Will - Despite suffering many centuries of thralldom, the will of the Stout-axes has never broken.

1879391216.name: Doom of Drása's Folk
1879391216.desc: Reduced Fate - Drása's Folk were a cruel people, and the Ring given to their king by Sauron led them into war against their kin. When the Dark Lord demanded the Ring's return, however, they refused, and his armies besieged and sacked their halls. The Enemy took many of the survivors back to Mordor as prisoners, forcing them to toil in the mines and pits of the Black Land for centuries. Stripped of their history, their clan name, and even their own language, they became a lost people. As years passed, they adopted a new clan name: the Stout-axes.
1879391216.tooltip: Reduced Fate - Drása's Folk were a cruel people, and the Ring given to their king by Sauron led them into war against their kin. When the Dark Lord demanded the Ring's return, however, they refused, and his armies besieged and sacked their halls. The Enemy took many of the survivors back to Mordor as prisoners, forcing them to toil in the mines and pits of the Black Land for centuries. Stripped of their history, their clan name, and even their own language, they became a lost people. As years passed, they adopted a new clan name: the Stout-axes.

1879391217.name: Wrought by the Black Land
1879391217.desc: Increased Might and Agility, improved resistance to Shadow and Disease - It is whispered that Sauron bred some among the Stout-axes using the same methods that had produced the mighty Uruk-hai and Olog-hai. Whether that is truly so is unknown, even to the Wise, but it is certain that the Stout-axes have grown accustomed to the unforgiving realm of Mordor.
1879391217.tooltip: Increased Might and Agility, improved resistance to Shadow and Disease - It is whispered that Sauron bred some among the Stout-axes using the same methods that had produced the mighty Uruk-hai and Olog-hai. Whether that is truly so is unknown, even to the Wise, but it is certain that the Stout-axes have grown accustomed to the unforgiving realm of Mordor.

1879467391.name: Caustic Brew

1879467392.tooltip: Grants the skill Call the Banners of War.

1879467393.tooltip: Grants the skill The West Wind.

1879467394.name: The Breaking of Thangorodrim
1879467394.desc: Grants access to The Breaking of Thangorodrim, a tale of the Elder Days that strikes fear into the hearts of your enemies.
1879467394.tooltip: Grants the skill The Breaking of Thangorodrim.

1879467428.name: Traveller
1879467428.desc: Your experience travelling has made you adept at regaining your balance.

1879467429.name: The South Wind
1879467429.desc: Grants access to The South Wind, which helps to quicken the pace of you and your allies. Subsequent ranks increase the potency of its effect.

1879467430.name: Confident Lunges
1879467430.desc: With your full weight behind them, your lunges will apply additional bleeds.

stats.description: Flèche and Lunge apply bleeds.

1879467431.name: Enheartening Songs
1879467431.desc: Your shanties rise above the din of battle, restoring some morale over time.

1879467432.name: Double-time
1879467432.desc: Shanty: Steady Fore becomes a short-duration skill which increases your fore-ward balance, melee damage, and run speed while active.

stats.description: Shanty: Steady Fore becomes Fore with Haste

1879467434.name: Test Defences
1879467434.desc: Every encounter is a learning process. When you land a critical Swordplay hit, you gain a tiering buff for a short time. Subsequent ranks will increase the max tier of this effect.

stats.description: Consecutive crits tier up to  *  times.

1879467435.name: Relaxing Wind
1879467435.desc: The winds are ever your allies at sea. Calling to any of the winds will restore some of your morale.

1879467436.name: Fighting Smarter
1879467436.desc: You make the most of any moments on your back foot.

1879467437.name: Sharpened Blades
1879467437.desc: Well-sharpened blades increase the damage of your swordplay skills.

1879467438.name: Conclusive Strike
1879467438.desc: Your swordplay finishers deal more damage.

1879467439.name: The Biting North Wind
1879467439.desc: The North Wind assails your foes, dealing additional damage.

1879467440.name: Compound Attack
1879467440.desc: Grants access to Compound Attack, a quick series of rapid strikes. Subsequent ranks will increase its damage.

1879467441.name: Stormy Seas
1879467441.desc: You are able to remain in unbalanced states for longer before you are forced to re-steady yourself.

1879467442.name: Guided by the Stars
1879467442.desc: The stars, Eärendil chief among them, are stoic reminders of your direction and purpose.

1879467443.name: Shocking Counterattack
1879467443.desc: Gain a chance to stun your enemies when following a Riposte with Advance.\n\nThis does not affect Sweeping Advance.

1879467444.name: Slashing Blade
1879467444.desc: Steeled resolve allows you to advance even when facing multiple foes.

stats.description: Advance becomes Sweeping Advance

1879467445.name: Booming Voice
1879467445.desc: Calling to the North Wind rouses your allies. \n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with a Captain's Rousing Cry buff.</rgb>

stats.description: The North Wind increases the damage of your allies by 5%.

1879467446.name: Entangling Lines
1879467446.desc: Grants access to thrown Bolas, which can entangle your foes, rooting them in place.

1879467447.name: Tempered Steel
1879467447.desc: Tempered steel blades improve your chances to critically hit with melee attacks.

1879467448.name: Dense Padding
1879467448.desc: Metal armour is a death sentence to anyone thrown overboard, so you're adept at making the most of cloth and leather equipment.

1879467449.name: Bloodied Foes
1879467449.desc: Grants access to Marked Foes, which marks enemies to increase the damage they take.

1879467450.name: Cleansing Salts
1879467450.desc: Your blade not only cleanses corruptions, but admonishes enemies when it does so.

1879467451.name: Ragged Knife
1879467451.desc: Even an old knife can be a useful tool.

1879467453.name: Encouraging Presence
1879467453.desc: Your ability to inspire your allies improves.

1879467454.name: Salt-sea Blade
1879467454.desc: Grants access to Salt-sea Blade, which reduces enemy armour by a small amount.

1879467455.name: One With the Sea
1879467455.desc: Combat, like the sea, has an ebb and a flow. You're able to better benefit from the positive effects of changing balance states.

1879467456.name: A Watched Pot
1879467456.desc: Watching a pot has never made it boil faster, but focusing on swordplay in the meantime makes the time pass more quickly.

1879467457.name: Rare Ingredients
1879467457.desc: Rare plants improve the quality of your spirits, helping them to better fortify you and your allies.

stats.description: Belly of Brine becomes Cleansing Spirits, a targeted skill.

1879467458.name: Keen Sight
1879467458.desc: Your keen sight gives your Steady Balance effect a bonus chance to critically hit.

1879467459.name: Many Hands
1879467459.desc: Shanties help synchronize the movements of your allies, making hard work feel a little easier.

1879467460.name: Novel Compounds
1879467460.desc: Your Volatile Salts utilize a novel recipe, and their dazes will be less likely to break immediately after they are applied.

1879467461.name: Deep Punctures
1879467461.desc: Strikes leave your enemies bleeding longer.

1879467462.name: A Duellist's Honour
1879467462.desc: You're most comfortable when fighting an opponent fairly, face to face.\n\nFor a Mariner, positional is achieved by being in front of an enemy.

1879467463.name: Spitting Spirits
1879467463.desc: Grants access to Breath of Fire, which becomes Breath of Ice when aft-ward.

1879467464.name: Careful Aim
1879467464.desc: Sometimes, circumstances demand a precision throw.

stats.description: Thrown skills become ground-targeted

1879467465.name: Motivating Melody
1879467465.desc: Grants access to Motivating Melody, a tune which restores and enheartens your allies.

1879467466.name: The Frigid North Wind
1879467466.desc: The North Wind gnaws at your foes, reducing their Critical Defence.

1879467468.name: Intimidating Challenge

1879467469.name: Masterful Disarm

stats.description: After Advance, Debilitating Strike will Disarm your opponent.

1879467470.name: Strong Arms
1879467470.desc: Your throwing arm is practiced at launching pots and other projectiles farther.

1879467471.name: Light of Spirit
1879467471.desc: After a life of travel, your spirit is lifted by even the smallest things.

1879467472.name: Coordinated Movement

stats.description: After Step Back or Check-step, Disengage heals your fellowship.

stats.description: After Blade Shield, Riposte increases the damage your target receives.

1879467474.name: Dodge

1879467475.name: Lean Forward

1879467476.name: Steady Winds
1879467476.desc: When you call on the Winds, they flow for longer.

1879467477.name: The Bitter North Wind
1879467477.desc: The North Wind dismays your foes, reducing their Incoming Healing.

1879467478.name: A Step Back
1879467478.desc: Increases the amount that Step Back and Check-step shift your balance aft-ward.

1879467479.name: Balanced Techniques
1879467479.desc: Not all victories are won through Offense. Increases the Damage of Aft-ward Skills.

1879467480.name: Firm Footing
1879467480.desc: You're so accustomed to the shifting of a deck that you move more quickly when steady.

1879467481.name: Shrug Aside Blows
1879467481.desc: Step back more confidently, further reducing the damage you take after you do so.

1879467482.name: Attacker's Advantage

stats.description: Thrust into Advance applies a Bleed
